newsitem.title: USA: PECO pins refinance hopes on Pa utility commission.
newsitem.headline: PECO pins refinance hopes on Pa utility commission.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said it will look to the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission (PUC) to approve its plan to refinance transition costs under deregulation after a judge Monday ruled against it.
An administrative law judge ruled against the company's plan to "securitize" $3.8 billion in mostly generation-related assets that the utility identified as "stranded costs".
"Wherever deregulation is being tried, as in California, securitization is the standard procedure," Neil McDermott, a spokesman for the utility, said Tuesday.
